native_dates: date-only API fields already identify provider-native calendar days; timestamp fields use site zone; whole calendar years inside metadata series window
population: all primary USGS daily-mean water-temperature stream site types in existing national combined metadata snapshot; one metadata-selected series per site
retain_opportunity: >=4 approved date-complete historical years and >=15 supported years with some approved observation; conditional on future numeric QC and predictor availability
scientific_scope: national availability census; no new water values, H30 trends or natural-gap validation
screen: cannot reach 15 fully supported calendar years is a metadata exclusion; unknown spans queried and never silently excluded
unapproved: observed provisional values are never recoded as true missing; any unapproved dates exclude that year from strict approved-data eligibility
